objective.en: Read a holiday post and photo captions and find where the writer went, what they did each day and what it was like.
objective.fr: Lire un post de vacances et des légendes de photos et trouver où l’auteur est allé, ce qu’il a fait chaque jour et comment c’était.
objective.de: Einen Urlaubspost und Fotounterschriften lesen und herausfinden, wohin der Autor gereist ist, was er jeden Tag gemacht hat und wie es war.

documents.title: Our week in Lisbon
paragraphs: Day 1: We arrived in Lisbon on Monday. The hotel is small, but the view from our room is amazing!
Day 2: We took the old yellow tram up to the castle. It was really crowded, so we stood for twenty minutes. The photos were worth it!
Day 3: We went to the beach at Cascais by train. The sea was freezing, so we only swam for five minutes. Then we ate fish and chips.
Last night: dinner by the river. The food was delicious and the people were friendly. We want to come back!
Hi everyone! We are in Edinburgh for the weekend. On Saturday we walked up to the castle. The view of the city was beautiful, but it was very cold and windy.
Sunday: We visited a museum in the morning. It was free and really interesting! In the afternoon we took a bus to the sea. Tomorrow we go home.
